propositions: The repository does not declare or enforce a minimum Git version floor for the merge-tree regression test, leaving it silently absent on Git < 2.38
A capability-skipping guard would allow the two-clone enrichment regression (bug 8185) to run conditionally, risking silent non-execution and vacuous test coverage

Git 2.38+ floor must be declared single-source (git-version-floor.txt), enforced at pytest session startup before test collection (raising UsageError on violation), and documented consistently across README, CONTRIBUTING, and local-dev-env.md
CI gates must verify the minimum Git version before the test job runs, failing loudly by runner name with diagnostics naming required vs. installed version
Non-vacuity guards must fail-closed when the merge-tree capability disappears due to module renames or splits, rather than silently scanning wrong paths
